title: Lemon basil seed-derived peptide: Hydrolysis, purification, and its role as a pancreatic lipase inhibitor that reduces adipogenesis by downregulating SREBP-1c and PPAR-gamma in 3T3-L1 adipocytes.
authors: Kuptawach, Kittisak; Noitung, Sajee; Buakeaw, Anumart; Puthong, Songchan; Sawangkeaw, Ruengwit; Sangtanoo, Papassara; Srimongkol, Piroonporn; Reamtong, Onrapak; Choowongkomon, Kiattawee; Karnchanatat, Aphichart
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柠檬罗勒种子肽抑制胰脂肪酶和脂肪生成，涉及蛋白-小分子/脂质代谢而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The purpose of this study is to assess the bioactive peptides derived from the defatted lemon basil seeds hydrolysate (DLSH) for their ability to inhibit pancreatic lipase, decrease intracellular lipid accumulation, and reduce adipogenesis. Response surface methodology (RSM) was employed to optimize trypsin hydrolysis conditions for maximizing lipase inhibitory activity (LI). A hydrolysis time of 387.06 min, a temperature of 49.03 degrees C, and an enzyme concentration of 1.61% w/v, resulted in the highest LI with an IC50 of 368.07 mug/mL. The ultrafiltration of the protein hydrolysate revealed that the fraction below 0.65kDa exhibited the greatest LI potential. Further purification via RP-HPLC identified the Gly-Arg-Ser-Pro-Asp-Thr-His-Ser-Gly (GRSPDTHSG) peptide in the HPLC fraction F1 using mass spectrometry. The peptide was synthesized and demonstrated LI with an IC50 of 0.255 mM through a non-competitive mechanism, with a constant (Ki) of 0.61 mM. Docking studies revealed its binding site with the pancreatic lipase-colipase complex. Additionally, GRSPDTHSG inhibited lipid accumulation in 3T3-L1 cells in a dose-dependent manner without cytotoxic effects. Western blot analysis indicated downregulation of PPAR-gamma and SREBP-1c levels under GRSPDTHSG treatment, while an increase in AMPK-alpha phosphorylation was observed, suggesting a role in regulating cellular lipid metabolism. Overall, GRSPDTHSG demonstrates potential in attenuating lipid absorption and adipogenesis, suggesting a prospective application in functional foods and nutraceuticals.
abstract_zh: 本研究的目的是评估来自脱脂柠檬罗勒种子水解物（DLSH）的生物活性肽抑制胰脂肪酶、减少细胞内脂质积累及降低脂肪生成的能力。采用响应面法（RSM）优化胰蛋白酶水解条件，以最大化脂肪酶抑制活性（LI）。水解时间387.06分钟、温度49.03摄氏度、酶浓度1.61% w/v时，获得最高LI，其IC50为368.07微克/毫升。蛋白质水解物的超滤结果显示，低于0.65kDa的组分表现出最大的LI潜力。通过RP-HPLC进一步纯化，利用质谱鉴定出HPLC组分F1中的Gly-Arg-Ser-Pro-Asp-Thr-His-Ser-Gly（GRSPDTHSG）肽。该肽经合成后，通过非竞争性机制表现出LI，IC50为0.255 mM，常数（Ki）为0.61 mM。对接研究揭示了其与胰脂肪酶-共脂酶复合物的结合位点。此外，GRSPDTHSG以剂量依赖性方式抑制3T3-L1细胞中的脂质积累，且无细胞毒性效应。Western blot分析表明，在GRSPDTHSG处理下，PPAR-γ和SREBP-1c水平下调，同时观察到AMPK-α磷酸化增加，提示其在调节细胞脂质代谢中发挥作用。总体而言，GRSPDTHSG在减弱脂质吸收和脂肪生成方面显示出潜力，表明其在功能食品和营养保健品中具有潜在应用前景。
